notes.title: Echoes of Argora – Beta Update #1
notes.content:
Greetings Argorians,



This marks the first major update following feedback from the ongoing closed beta. The game is now officially being tested by my dedicated Test Team, and I'm excited to share that the feedback has been overwhelmingly positive.

This update focuses on refining core systems, improving player feedback, and resolving early quest and combat issues. Here's what's included:


Gameplay & Combat Improvements
Core combat systems have been refined, including improvements to blocking, parrying, stagger mechanics, and AI behavior for key encounters.


Quest & Event Fixes
Issues related to early quest progression and world event logic have been addressed, with additional support added for persistent world state tracking.


Player Experience Tuning
Adjustments have been made to player movement, animation timing, and clarity in combat to create a more responsive and immersive experience.


Environmental & World Updates
Several environmental hazards now behave as expected, visual feedback has been enhanced, and collision issues in key locations have been resolved.



Thanks again to the Test Team for the continued feedback, your input is shaping the world of Argora into something truly amazing!



Philip
Echoes of Argora

notes.title: Controller Support Is Here + Upcoming QA Test
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I am excited to share that full gamepad support has now been added to Echoes of Argora. This means that you will be able to enjoy the entire experience from the couch, no keyboard or mouse needed.

In addition to that, I'm getting ready for the third round of QA testing, which is just around the corner. This is a crucial step as I continue to polish and refine the game ahead of release.

Thank you for your patience and support. More updates will be coming soon!

- Emerald Studio Sweden
